verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of agent instruction files (SKILL.md) installed into your repo or as a plugin. It operates no service that stores user data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it holding, retaining or offering deletion of user data; the 'ordinary files you own' material is about editing and updating the skill files, not data retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
